🆕 New (Published: August 21, 2026)

Donations are being accepted for relief of those affected by the heavy rain disaster in Chiba in August 2026 (Reiwa 8).

【Donations at Hanno City Hall】
A donation box is set up at the Information Counter (1st floor) of Hanno City Hall Main Building. Those requesting a receipt should visit the Community Welfare Division (Window 11, 1st floor of the same building).

Acceptance period: August 21 (Friday) – November 24 (Tuesday), 2026
Acceptance hours: Weekdays 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM

【Bank transfer】
If you prefer to donate directly to the Japanese Red Cross Society, please transfer to the following account. The acceptance period is August 21 (Friday) – November 30 (Monday), 2026.

Japan Post Bank / Post Office: Account number 00100-2-636358 | Account name: Japanese Red Cross Chiba Heavy Rain Relief Fund R8
(Counter transfers have no fee. The post office payment slip stub serves as a receipt for tax purposes.)

Bank transfers:
Sumitomo Mitsui Bank Suzuran Branch | Ordinary account 2787556
Mitsubishi UFJ Bank Yamabiko Branch | Ordinary account 2105554
Mizuho Bank Kunugi Branch | Ordinary account 0620839
Account name: Japanese Red Cross Society
(Bank transfer receipt serves as a receipt for tax purposes.)

All donations received will be sent in full to those affected by the disaster. Thank you for your support.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/chiikifukushika/fukushisoumu/14307.html
summary: ℹ️ Donations accepted for August 2026 Chiba heavy rain disaster relief
